title: Immutable registry-handle potential characterization
question: How much warm exact-key cache cost is attributable to deep assignment of the immutable adaptive hydraulic table, and what lower-cost bound is exposed by returning only the stable registry slot?
research_change: Add a collision-safe cache find_slot method that returns the occupied registry slot for an exact-key hit without copying the table. It is not used by the production provider in F-AHL37.
measurements: seconds per current cache lookup with table deep assignment
seconds per exact-key slot lookup without table assignment
